A FEW USEFUL ANSWERS

Before we
get started.

Can I contact Sevlink as a homeowner or landlord?＋

Yes. Call, WhatsApp or prepare an enquiry below. You do not need a portal account to ask us about work at your property.

Do I need a quote or a call-out?＋

Tell us what is wrong and share photos where possible. We can discuss whether the work can be quoted from the information supplied or whether attendance is needed first.

Who is the property portal for?＋

The portal is designed for property agencies, their property managers and linked tenants. Homeowners and private landlords can deal directly with Sevlink.

Can you help with a renovation?＋

Yes—get in touch about kitchens, bathrooms, painting, tiling or wider refurbishment work. We will discuss the scope, property location and the next step.
